summary: Executed external API regression suite and UI smoke/integration checks. Backend core flows passed, but browser-based auth/register is blocked by origin validation (403), preventing protected UI flows.

critical.endpoint: /api/auth/register (also impacts /api/auth/login and other non-GET browser calls)
critical.issue: Requests with Origin header from real browser context are rejected with 403 'Request origin not permitted.'

ui_bugs.issue: Email registration from UI fails with backend error 'Request origin not permitted.'

integration_issues.issue: Cannot proceed to dashboard/listing CRUD/bookings via browser because auth POST is blocked by server origin middleware.

action_items: Fix origin validation middleware so browser Origin requests from https://estates-marketplace.preview.emergentagent.com are accepted for non-GET APIs.
After origin fix, retest UI auth/register/login, owner listing CRUD/dashboard, favorites, inquiry, booking and payment-status screens end-to-end.
Add request-origin debug logging temporarily (origin, host, x-forwarded-host) to verify ingress header handling and prevent regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py security middleware currently rejects legitimate browser-origin POSTs, effectively breaking all authenticated UX despite API logic being functional via non-browser clients.
Auth-gated features are untestable in browser until middleware mismatch is resolved; this is a release-blocking integration defect.

success_rate.frontend: 55% (public navigation/responsive passed; protected flows blocked by auth-origin failure)

test_credentials: No reusable credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (file contains only template header). Temporary API and UI test users were generated during tests.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary users and temporary non-sample properties via API tests; property cleanup executed in test teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints were validated against external preview URL and are mostly healthy (filters/sort/pagination, ownership, favorites, inquiries, quote rules, upload/media, Stripe-safe 503 behavior). Main blocker is browser Origin-based 403 on auth/register, reproducible with Playwright and curl when Origin header is present.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: 1) Open /signin, switch to create account, submit valid form. 2) API response is 403 'Request origin not permitted.' 3) Same 403 reproduced with curl when sending Origin header for preview domain. 4) Without Origin header, API succeeds (as seen in pytest). Likely root cause is server.py origin guard logic mismatching ingress/browser origin headers. Mitigation: normalize and trust validated host/origin combinations behind proxy, and include strict but correct comparison for forwarded proto/host values.
